name: 2D Gaussian Splatting Rasterization
definition: Tier-1 NumPy reference rasterization for 2D Gaussian Splatting (surfels) that performs ray-surfel intersection per pixel using the M matrix from projection, accumulating colour, alpha, and normal maps via front-to-back alpha compositing.
summary: 2D Gaussian Splatting Rasterization renders scenes using planar surfels with 2D covariance structures, differing from 3D Gaussian Splatting by simplifying intersection geometry through specific surfel plane orientation handling.
